capabilities: Convert Obsidian Markdown to Confluence storage HTML
Update existing Confluence pages by frontmatter page ID or title lookup
Create new pages under an optional parent page
Upload image embeds and local image links as Confluence attachments
Write the Confluence page ID back into note frontmatter
extras: Setup requires building from source (npm install, npm run build) and copying files to the plugin folder; the README also includes a community plugin release checklist. Non-image embeds are not uploaded and become plain text markers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push a note's content into a Confluence space as a page.

relations.evidence: Sync the active note from Obsidian to Confluence using the REST API.

summary: Confluence publisher that syncs the active note to Confluence via REST API, converting Markdown to Confluence storage HTML and creating or updating pages.
